record.name: CultureBlocs: Creative × Tech Autumn Meetup
record.description: A friendly London evening for people at every stage — tech-curious, practitioners, technologists and founders — to share projects and problems and talk about what technology and data can do for the creative and cultural sector. Arrivals and drinks from 18:30, a welcome to CultureBlocs, informal shares, open conversation and newcomer-friendly networking in small groups. Hosted by Mark Simpkins and Oliver Outen.
